verdict.rationale: Refunds are a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never mentions refunds of any kind. It does not cover full or partial refunds, refunds to the original card, or refunds issued from the point of sale, the Dashboard or an API. The only nearby item is the Disputes API, which handles chargebacks rather than merchant-initiated refunds and so earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API
